title: Guest Surcharges Added to the Charge Carried to Pay
content:
Guests brought to the counter on an Employee Meal Account add to what is carried to the employee's pay, and once a run of them has passed the allowance the plan prints, the guest meals themselves are added as well.

**Clause.** Where the plan allows guest meals and more guest meals have been rung on the account in the three calendar months running back from the day the account is worked than three times the guest meal allowance printed against the plan, one month's allowance for each of those three months, the guest surcharge due is that printed surcharge counted once for each of them, rounded to two decimal places at that step, together with the whole value of those guest meals, since the allowance no longer covers them. Where the plan allows guest meals and at least one guest meal has been rung in the three calendar months running back from the day the account is worked within that three-month allowance, the guest surcharge due is that printed surcharge counted once for each of them, rounded to two decimal places at that step. Where neither holds, no guest surcharge is added.

## The plan figures this reads

| Meal plan | Guest meals allowed | Guest meals allowed in one calendar month | Guest surcharge printed against the plan |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pay-As-You-Go Badge Account | no | 0 | $0.00 |
| Prepaid Declining Balance Account | yes | 4 | $4.50 |
| Payroll Deduction Meal Account | yes | 4 | $4.50 |
| Subsidized Daily Allowance Account | yes | 2 | $5.25 |
| Full Subsidy Employee Meal Account | no | 0 | $0.00 |
| Executive Dining Charge Account | yes | 20 | $12.00 |

Three times the monthly guest meal allowance is therefore 12 guest meals on the Prepaid Declining Balance Account and on the Payroll Deduction Meal Account, 6 on the Subsidized Daily Allowance Account and 60 on the Executive Dining Charge Account.

## The bands

| Plan allows guest meals | Guest meals rung in the three calendar months running back from the day the account is worked | Added to the charge |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | More than three times the printed monthly allowance | The printed surcharge for each of them, plus the whole value of those guest meals |
| Yes | At least one, and no more than three times that allowance | The printed surcharge for each of them |
| Yes | None | Nothing |
| No | Any | Nothing |

*Hypothetical illustration.* On a plan printing a monthly guest meal allowance of 2 and a guest surcharge of $5.25, 7 guest meals in the three calendar months running back from the day the account is worked are past the three-month allowance of 6, so the amount added is $5.25 counted 7 times, or $36.75, together with the whole value of those 7 guest meals, say $84.00, giving $120.75. The same account with 5 guest meals in that stretch, worth $60.00, adds only $26.25.
